item.title: Millwall to host 'Community Day' v Blackburn Rovers
item.description: Millwall Football Club is pleased to announce that The Lions' Sky Bet Championship fixture against Blackburn Rovers on Saturday 14th March will host the club's annual Community Day. Community Day will enable Millwall Community Trust to showcase the range of programmes that the club offers to the local community. item.title: Ipswich Town v Millwall to be shown on Sky Sports and ITV
item.description: Millwall's trip to Ipswich Town will be shown LIVE on Sky Sports Football and ITV. The Sky Bet Championship fixture will remain on Saturday 21st March, but will now kick-off at 12.30pm. Tickets for the trip to Portman Road will go on sale soon - check millwallfc.co.uk for further details. As a reminder, selections for matches will now be announced weekly, based on a four-week rolling basis. For example, next week’s announcement will cover the period around the weekend of 28th March.

item.title: The EFL Puma Rainbow Ball is back!
item.description: Millwall Football Club is proud to support the return of the EFL PUMA Rainbow Ball, which serves as a symbol of inclusion, unity and pride and will feature across all Sky Bet EFL matches from 20th February to 1st March, including the fixtures against Portsmouth and Birmingham City on Saturday 21st and Wednesday 25th February respectively at The Den. item.title: Preview | Millwall v Portsmouth
item.description: Millwall take on Portsmouth at The Den in the Sky Bet Championship on Saturday afternoon (kick-off 3pm). After back-to-back away wins at Wrexham and Sheffield Wednesday, The Lions now begin back-to-back home fixtures as Pompey visit SE16. Head Coach Alex Neil has no fresh injury worries, meaning Joe Bryan, Dan Kelly, Will Smallbone, Lukas Jensen and Massimo Luongo remain the squad members on the sidelines.
